entries.title: The collapsed Activity line keeps your keyboard place when you reach it just as a newer line arrives
entries.body: Pressing Shift+Tab onto the line in a collapsed Activity panel's header, at the moment a newer line was replacing it, could send you to the message box. You now stay on the line, which shows the newer words.
entries.noPicture: Where the keyboard's place stays in the moment one line replaces another cannot show in a still picture.
